protocol: Same original PDF, selected 10 pages processed sequentially, one pass per parser on same GPU. PDF decoding/rasterization and materializing returned text/tables included. Diagnostic artifact writes and scoring excluded. Warm means models loaded, not warmup inference. Cold is cached-model startup plus requests, not fresh installation/download. Network upload, HTTP/frontend, queuing, DB, and workflow execution excluded.
